summary: Secluded bush kerb, but narrow lane with trees at the edge and no room to pull off.
reasons: Trees right at the kerb, no pull-off
No parking seen along this lane
Secluded but nowhere clear to stop

drivers.seclusion: No dwellings nearby; bush on this side, park and playing fields on the other.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane through park and bush; tree canopy meets the north edge and there is no verge or pull-off, so a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through route through the park; a single red car in the 2022 QLD image, none in the Esri image.
drivers.convention: No marked or customary parking along this stretch.

flags: Low-lying: about 8-10 m elevation, a waterway 37 m away
cannot_judge: Whether a pull-off exists under the canopy
